desc: Measure public DNS resolver latency and pick the fastest one, with its DNS IP and DoH URL; also time the TLS handshake to each IP a domain resolves to.
meta.description: Measure public DNS resolver latency and pick the fastest one, with its DNS IP and DoH URL; also time the TLS handshake to each IP a domain resolves to.
meta.title: DNS Optimizer - S-Jiffy
ui.hint: Latency is the HTTP round trip measured in your browser (median of 5 samples per resolver). It reflects how fast this network reaches that resolver DoH endpoint, not the lookup speed after you change your DNS settings. Resolvers marked "latency only" do not send CORS headers, so their answers cannot be read.
ui.ipHint: Handshake time is a lower bound of the TCP+TLS connection to that IP over HTTPS, excluding page content. When the certificate does not match the host, the browser fails right after the handshake, and the time is still usable for comparing routes. It is not a download speed.
ui.noIp: No IPv4 address resolved (or the resolvers are unavailable)
ui.noResolver: No resolver is usable: the current network may block all DoH services
ui.offline: You are offline, so the test cannot run
